title: Defective product bought online, no refund
user_input: I ordered a mixer grinder from an online store called HomeKart on 2 October 2025 and paid ₹8,000 by UPI. It was delivered on 6 October. When I used it the first time, the motor started smoking and stopped working. I raised a return request on 7 October (ticket number HK-558213) and the courier picked it up on 10 October. The website showed 'refund initiated' on 12 October but I have not received any money until today, and customer care keeps giving the same answer. I live in Jaipur. I have the invoice, UPI payment screenshot, and a video of the smoke.

I have attached copies of the supporting documents.
